getBucket(uint256).details: Reverts if the bucket is ahead of the current one or has already been overwritten in the ring

getBucketAtOrBeforeTotal(uint64).details: Cumulative totals strictly increase with the bucket sequence (every opened bucket absorbs at least one message), so the result is the newest retained bucket whose end position does not exceed the bound. Probes the newest four live entries first, then binary-searches the remaining live interval. Only ring entries that have not been overwritten are candidates; the genesis bucket qualifies only while its ring entry is still live. Reverts with `Inbox__NoBucketAtOrBeforeTotal` when even the oldest retained bucket ends past the bound.

params._upperBound: - The cumulative message total the returned bucket may not exceed

returns._0: The sequence number of the matching bucket and the bucket itself

getRingHeadroom().details: Counts bucket openings, not messages: at zero, messages can still be absorbed into the current bucket until it fills or its L1 block passes. Equals the ring size at genesis and recovers as proofs advance the proven-consumed record.

returns._0: The number of buckets that can still be opened

markProvenConsumed(uint64).details: Only callable by the rollup. Monotonic: a value at or below the current record is a no-op. Reverts with `Inbox__Unauthorized` if the caller is not the rollup, and with `Inbox__BucketOutOfWindow` if `_bucketSeq` is ahead of the current bucket.

params._bucketSeq: - The sequence number of the newest bucket the proven chain has consumed

sendL2Message((bytes32,uint256),bytes32,.details: Emits `MessageSent` with data for easy access by the sequencer

params._content: - The content of the message (application specific)
params._secretHash: - The secret hash of the message (make it possible to hide when a specific message is consumed on L2)

returns._0: The key of the message in the set and its compact cumulative index

getBucket(uint256).notice: Returns the bucket with the given sequence number

getBucketAtOrBeforeTotal(uint64).notice: Returns the live bucket with the greatest cumulative message total at or below `_upperBound`

getCurrentBucketSeq().notice: Returns the sequence number of the bucket currently accumulating messages

getProvenConsumedBucketSeq().notice: Returns the sequence number of the newest bucket consumed by the proven chain

getRingHeadroom().notice: Returns the number of buckets that can still be opened before `sendL2Message` reverts to protect an unconsumed bucket from being overwritten

markProvenConsumed(uint64).notice: Records that the proven chain has consumed all messages up to and including bucket `_bucketSeq`, unlocking eviction of buckets at or below it when the ring wraps

sendL2Message((bytes32,uint256),bytes32,.notice: Inserts a new message into the Inbox
